title: Dun Dun Dunnn!
blurb: A melodramatic orchestral sting that has been announcing shocking revelations since radio drama, and parodying itself for nearly as long. That self-awareness is what makes it so usable now — nobody plays this sincerely any more, so the sound arrives pre-loaded with irony. Play it when somebody reveals they forgot to buy milk. The larger the gap between the gravity of the chord and the triviality of the news, the harder it lands. Essential punctuation for fake-serious storytelling of every kind, and impossible to overuse in a group chat.
origin: The classic melodrama sting, parodied since radio-drama days.
